title: Rust, Go and C# in the browser
summary: A service written in Rust, Go, C#, F#, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Dart or Ruby can run in the browser as WebAssembly, a compiled format that browsers run. Lua and Python services run there too, on runtimes that Tachyon ships, with limits. In a desktop or mobile app, Swift, Kotlin, C# and Rust services can run as native code instead.
